# OSS-REFACTOR-TESTS: externalize the three in-module test files ## Intent Three engine source files exceed 1000 LOC **only** because of in-module test code. Move that test code into `tests/` submodule directories, split by concern, so each production file drops below 1000 LOC. This is a **pure move** — zero production-behaviour risk — and is the Tier-0 warm-up for the refactor program (#914). ## Current State (ground truth — read before changing anything) | file | LOC | what the in-module tests cover | |------|-----|-------------------------------| | `engine/src/execution_engine/tests.rs` | **2634** | `ParallelExecutionServiceImpl` + `RetryEvaluationServiceImpl` | | `engine/src/planning/tests.rs` | **2203** | `PlanningPipelineImpl`, `MockClassifier`/`MockParameterExtractor`, planning hash, error paths | | `engine/src/dag_engine/tests.rs` | **1230** | `TaskGraph` construction, Kahn topo sort, cycle detection, ready queue, node completion | Each file is a `tests` module included by its parent (`engine/src/.rs` or `mod.rs`). Header comments in each file state what they cover. ## Target State Each becomes a `tests/` submodule **directory** split by concern, wired from the parent with `#[cfg(test)] mod tests;`: ``` engine/src/execution_engine/tests/{approval,retry,dispatch,hooks}.rs engine/src/planning/tests/{pipeline,hash,errors}.rs engine/src/dag_engine/tests/{graph,topo,ready,completion}.rs ``` Same test names + assertions; only relocation + module wiring. ## In Scope - Move the test code; split into focused files; update the module declarations. - Keep every `#[test]` — the total count must not change. ## Out of Scope - Any test-logic change. - Any production change beyond the module declaration. ## Affected Layers - **engine** — `execution_engine/{tests.rs,mod.rs}`, `planning/{tests.rs,mod.rs}`, `dag_engine/{tests.rs,mod.rs}` ## Canonical References - Precedent: Rust `#[cfg(test)] mod tests;` externalization (no harness change). - Program umbrella: **#914** (OSS-REFACTOR-PROGRAM) — Tier 0. ## Acceptance Criteria | # | Criterion | Verify in | |---|-----------|-----------| | 1 | The three sources drop below 1000 LOC; `#[test]` count unchanged | `cargo test -- --list` (count before/after) | | 2 | `cargo test --workspace` green — same tests, same results | CI | | 3 | No production code changed (only module declarations) | `git diff` review | ## Implementation Steps 1. Record the test count: `cargo test -p rigorix-engine -- --list | wc -l` (or grep `#[test]`). 2. Create the `tests/` directory next to each file; split the module body into focused files. 3. Replace the in-file `mod tests { … }` with `#[cfg(test)] mod tests;` (+ `mod ;` children). 4. Move shared `#[cfg(test)]` helpers into `tests/common.rs` with `pub(crate)` visibility. 5. Re-run the count and `cargo test --workspace`; confirm parity. ## Notes / Gotchas - **Count the tests before/after** — a move must not silently drop a `#[test]`. - Shared `#[cfg(test)]` helpers → a `tests/common.rs` (`pub(crate)`), not duplicated. - If a parent declares `mod tests;` unconditionally, keep the `#[cfg(test)]` attribute on the child.
title: OSS-REFACTOR-TESTS: externalize the 3 in-module test files >1000 LOC (pure move)

# OSS-REFACTOR-ORCHESTRATOR: split the 4166-line coordinator ## Intent `engine/src/orchestrator/application/orchestrator_impl.rs` is 4166 lines: one struct + ctor builders, ~14 private helpers, the `OrchestratorService` trait impl, and ~2000 lines of in-module tests. Extract the approval flow + effect-key extraction, externalize the tests, and compose the plan-time gates into a single `PolicyPipeline`. Target: a ~1200–1500 line coordinator. ## Dependencies - **#914** (umbrella) — Tier 1 item #1. - **#917** (test externalization) — recommended first. ## Current State (ground truth — read before changing anything) `engine/src/orchestrator/application/orchestrator_impl.rs`: ``` l.56 pub struct OrchestratorServiceImpl { ... } l.75 struct CurrentExecutionState { ... } l.83-785 private helpers: collect_scoring_results:178 · build_module_deps:229 · run_effect_key:273 (the /effect_key derivation) · build_record:291 · make_pending_state:330 · make_final_state:337 · build_graph_from_steps:396 · enforce_identity_requirement:440 · apply_plan_time_sequence_policy:467 · apply_plan_time_requirements:579 · extract_file_paths:691 · detect_git_info:731 l.786 impl OrchestratorService: run:788 · plan_only:1302 · cancel:1326 · status:1372 · run_from_template:1389 · plan_from_template:1962 · event_bus:2002 · approve_execution:2006 (the approval flow) · execution_state:2143 l.2163 #[cfg(test)] mod tests (~2000 LOC; doubles CapturingAuditService:2175, FailPlan:2475) l.4102 another #[cfg(test)] ``` M-15 rider: `approval_records` flows into envelopes (`execution_engine/application/service_impl.rs:3228`) but the `ExecutionState` field is absent. ## Target State New single-responsibility modules under `orchestrator/application/`: - `approval_flow.rs` — `approve_execution` + pause/resume/re-approval - `effect_key.rs` — `run_effect_key` + its seam - `policy_pipeline.rs` — a composed pipeline `SequencePolicy → Approval → Dispatch`, replacing the inline match arms in `run` - tests moved out (#917) → `orchestrator/tests/{run,plan,policies,approval}.rs` - `orchestrator_impl.rs` becomes the coordinator (~1200–1500 LOC) ## In Scope 1. **First (pure move):** move the test module (`l.2163+`, doubles) out — ~2000 LOC, zero risk. 2. Extract `ApprovalFlow` from `approve_execution`. 3. Extract `EffectKeyExtractor` from `run_effect_key`. 4. Compose `PolicyPipeline`; **preserve the exact order + fail-closed semantics**. 5. Fold in the M-15 rider **only if** it stays a pure move. ## Out of Scope - Behaviour changes to the gates (move + compose only). - Other Tier-1/2 files (#914). ## Affected Layers - **engine** — `orchestrator/application/orchestrator_impl.rs` (modify); `orchestrator/application/{approval_flow,effect_key,policy_pipeline}.rs` (create); `orchestrator/tests/*.rs` (create) ## Canonical References - `engine/.pi/architecture/modules/orchestrator.md` - `engine/src/orchestrator/application/orchestrator_impl.rs` (symbols above) - `engine/src/sequence_policy/application/service.rs` (`SequencePolicyService` — the plan-time gate) - Precedent: #888-PR-A (pure move + tests) ## Acceptance Criteria | # | Criterion | Verify in | |---|-----------|-----------| | 1 | `orchestrator_impl.rs` < ~1500 LOC; new modules single-responsibility | review | | 2 | No public-surface change without a note; ALL existing orchestrator tests pass (same count) | tests | | 3 | `cargo test --workspace` + clippy `-D warnings` green | CI | | 4 | Plan-time gate order + fail-closed semantics unchanged (add an ordering assertion) | test | ## Implementation Steps 1. Move the tests out (pure move) → shrinks ~2000 LOC. 2. Extract `ApprovalFlow` (`approve_execution:2006`). 3. Extract `EffectKeyExtractor` (`run_effect_key:273`). 4. Compose `PolicyPipeline` around `apply_plan_time_sequence_policy:467` + `apply_plan_time_requirements:579`. 5. Add an ordering assertion for the gates. ## Notes / Gotchas - The plan-time gates are **security-critical** (ADR-015 identity/params; R2/R9 sequence policy). The composed pipeline MUST preserve the exact order + fail-closed behaviour. - `run` (`l.788`, ~500 LOC) is the hot spot — split its phases (plan → gates → dispatch → finalize) rather than moving the whole body. - Do **not** rename public items (`OrchestratorServiceImpl`, trait methods) — the engine is composed elsewhere.

# OSS-MCP-STREAMABLE-HTTP: optional MCP HTTP transport ## Intent ADR-0001 **D4** keeps a MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint as an *optional* adapter over the frozen `rigorix.*` catalog, gated on GUI-agent adoption. This records it (trigger-gated) with the shape so it can be built quickly when triggered. ## Dependencies - ADR-0001 D4 + `rigorix-oss` #888 (`rigorix-server`) — MERGED. - **Trigger:** a demonstrated GUI-agent need for MCP-over-HTTP (stdio + `rigorix-server` cover today's use). Do not build speculatively. ## Current State (ground truth — read before changing anything) - `rigorix-server` (`server/src/main.rs`) serves `POST /rpc` + `GET /events` only. - The MCP surface today is stdio (`mcp/src/main.rs`) + the server's catalog; **no** Streamable HTTP endpoint exists. - Reuse points: `server/src/catalog.rs` (`AuthLevel` + `mcp_tool` mapping), `server/src/rpc.rs` (the D4 gate), `server/src/backend.rs` (`HostBackend` → `rigorix_mcp::host`, the SAME dispatcher the stdio binary uses), `mcp/src/host` (tool descriptors). - Legitimate MCP-over-HTTP must reuse this governed surface — **no raw-step escape hatch** (ADR-0001 D6/D10). Do **not** resurrect the legacy MCP SSE (GAP-A-10). ## Target State **When triggered:** an MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint on `rigorix-server` that adapts the frozen catalog: - `initialize` / `tools/list` / `tools/call` mapped onto catalog methods (governed flows only), - session semantics + SSE-per-request per the MCP Streamable HTTP spec, - the **same** auth (`AuthLevel`) + team scope as `/rpc`, - no raw-step execution; catalog parity preserved. ## In Scope - (when triggered) the transport adapter + session handling + tool-list mapping. - (when triggered) conformance: exposed tools == the catalog's governed subset. ## Out of Scope - Building it now (trigger-gated). - Legacy MCP SSE (do not). ## Affected Layers - **server** — `server/src/` (new route, when triggered) - **mcp** — reuse `mcp/src/host` tool descriptors ## Canonical References - `rigorix-sdk docs/adr/ADR-0001-native-api-catalog.md` (D4, D6, D10, GAP-A-10) - `rigorix-oss docs/sdk-server-strategy-freeze-2026-09-06.md` (D-4) - `server/src/rpc.rs`, `server/src/catalog.rs`, `server/src/backend.rs`, `mcp/src/host` ## Acceptance Criteria | # | Criterion | Verify in | |---|-----------|-----------| | 1 | (when triggered) a GUI agent can drive governed flows over MCP Streamable HTTP | integration | | 2 | No raw-step escape hatch; catalog parity preserved; same auth as `/rpc` | conformance | | 3 | CI green | CI | ## Implementation Steps 1. Confirm the trigger. 2. Map MCP `tools/*` onto catalog methods via `HostBackend`; add the session/streaming layer. 3. Conformance test: exposed tools == catalog governed subset. ## Notes / Gotchas - It is a **thin transport mapping**: catalog + `HostBackend` already exist; only the MCP framing/session layer is new. - Never expose raw step execution; never resurrect legacy MCP SSE.
title: OSS-MCP-STREAMABLE-HTTP: optional MCP Streamable HTTP transport (trigger-gated, ADR-0001 D4)

Guardian contract (machine-readable front matter — parsed by the Guardian pipeline) ```yaml guardian_issue: id: "OSS-SERVER-SSE-AUTH" title: "Gate GET /events — apply the same session gate as POST /rpc, or enforce localhost-only" epic: "server mode — C2 hardening (ADR-0005/ADR-0008)" status: planned priority: medium created_at: "2026-09-25T00:00:00Z" dependencies: - name: "OSS #900/#888 (GET /events SSE + bridge) — MERGED" type: internal validators: [ci, tests, security, architecture] pipeline_steps: [implement, validate, create-mr, merge] ```
# OSS-SERVER-SSE-AUTH: gate `GET /events` ## Intent `GET /events` streams run events with **no session gate**, while `POST /rpc` enforces the ADR-0001 D4 auth level per method. The server binds `127.0.0.1` by default, but a non-loopback `RIGORIX_SERVER_BIND` would expose an **unauthenticated event stream**. Close the gap with the **same** gate the RPC path uses. ## Dependencies - `rigorix-oss` #900/#888 (`GET /events` + the live bridge) — MERGED. ## Current State (ground truth — read before changing anything) - Mount (`server/src/main.rs:53`): `.route("/events", get(events_handler))` — no middleware. `.route("/rpc", post(rpc_handler))` is likewise bare but `rpc_handler` enforces auth internally. - **Reference gate** (`server/src/rpc.rs:118-140`): ```rust match entry.auth { AuthLevel::Public => {} AuthLevel::Session => if backend.auth_configured().await && !backend.is_authenticated().await { reject not_authenticated } AuthLevel::Admin => { ... } } ``` - `events_handler` (`server/src/events.rs:171`) — `State(state), HeaderMap, Query`; subscribes immediately, **no auth check**. - `ServerState::new(Arc::new(HostBackend), hub)` (`main.rs:48`) — the backend **is** on the state. - `HostBackend` auth (`server/src/backend.rs:55-65`): `auth_configured() = app_state().auth_handler.is_some()`; `is_authenticated() = auth_handler.current_engine_identity().await.is_some()`. - Bind default: `RIGORIX_SERVER_BIND` = `"127.0.0.1:3001"` (`main.rs:38`). ## Target State Choose **one** and implement it explicitly: - **(A) Gate** — in `events_handler`, before subscribing: ```rust if state.backend.auth_configured().await && !state.backend.is_authenticated().await { return (StatusCode::UNAUTHORIZED, "...").into_response(); } ``` (Fail closed when an IdP is configured; preserve the local/legacy no-IdP mode, matching the RPC path exactly.) - **(B) Localhost-only** — refuse to bind a non-loopback address (reject a `RIGORIX_SERVER_BIND` that is not `127.0.0.1`/`::1`) and document the decision. ## In Scope - Implement (A) or (B); add tests in **both** directions. - (A): resolve auth **once at connect** (long-lived stream). - (B): a startup test that a non-loopback bind is refused. - Document the posture in `server/.pi/architecture/modules/rigorix-server.md`. ## Out of Scope - The enterprise SSE push (#218); new transport. ## Affected Layers - **server** — `server/src/events.rs` (`events_handler`) or `server/src/main.rs` (bind guard) - **docs** — `server/.pi/architecture/modules/rigorix-server.md` ## Canonical References - `mcp/.pi/architecture/decisions/ADR-008-auth-client-flow.md`; ADR-0005 - `server/src/rpc.rs:118` (the reference gate), `server/src/backend.rs:55`, `server/src/main.rs:35-55`, `server/src/events.rs:171` ## Acceptance Criteria | # | Criterion | Verify in | |---|-----------|-----------| | 1 | `GET /events` requires a valid session when an IdP is configured (fail closed), OR a non-loopback bind is refused | test | | 2 | Behaviour matches the RPC path exactly (no-IdP short-circuit preserved) | test | | 3 | A test proves the chosen behaviour (authorised stream vs rejected; or refused non-loopback) | CI | | 4 | `rigorix-server.md` documents the posture | review | | 5 | CI green (fmt/clippy/tests) | CI | ## Implementation Steps 1. Read `rpc.rs:118-140` + `backend.rs:55-65` (the predicate to reuse). 2. (A) Add the guard at the top of `events_handler`; or (B) add a bind-address check before `TcpListener::bind` (`main.rs:55`). 3. Add the test(s). 4. Document the posture in `rigorix-server.md`. ## Notes / Gotchas - **Reuse** `backend.auth_configured()/is_authenticated()` — do not add a second auth path. - Check auth **once at connect** — per-event checks would be wrong and costly. - The RPC gate **short-circuits when no IdP is configured** (local mode); preserve that or local deployments lose the stream. - (B) must treat `::1` as loopback too.
title: OSS-SERVER-SSE-AUTH: gate `GET /events` (fail-closed) or enforce localhost-only

Both halves are verified against the SAME SDK fixtures, but nothing proves rigorix-server's HttpAnchorClient actually talks to the enterprise over the wire — and inspection shows it CANNOT (see Current State). Build the live E2E AND fix/reconcile the wire. acceptable_criteria: 7 validators: [ci, tests, integration, architecture, canonical] pipeline_steps: [implement, validate, create-mr, merge] ```
# OSS-ANCHOR-WIRE-E2E: prove the anchored path over the wire ## Intent Fixture parity is **not** wire parity. The OSS host's anchor client and the enterprise anchor have only ever been tested against the **same SDK fixtures** (which bypass the transport). Nothing proves they interoperate over HTTP — and inspection proves they **cannot today**. Build the live end-to-end test + demo for the anchored path, after reconciling the wire. ## Dependencies - **`rigorix-oss` #899** (Phase C engine) — MERGED `bc5ea460`. - **`rigorix-enterprise` #215 `ENT-ANCHOR-ENDPOINT`** — **must land first**; it reconciles the wire. - **`rigorix-sdk` #34 `SDK-CRATES-0.2.0`** — the E2E must run on a verifier that knows `anchor_head`. ## Current State (ground truth — read before changing anything) **OSS client** — `engine/src/audit/infrastructure/anchor.rs`: ```rust // impl AnchorSliceSource for HttpAnchorClient (line 268) let url = format!("{}/v1/history", self.base_url.trim_end_matches('/')); self.http.get(url) .query(&[("scope", scope), ("since", since.as_str())]) .send().await? .json::().await // expects a BARE HistorySlice // AnchorRuntime::fetch_verified (line 226) let slice = source.fetch_slice(&self.scope, since).await?; verify_slice(&slice, key)?; // Ed25519 over signing_bytes() if slice.scope != self.scope { return Err(InvalidSlice) } // scope must match self.set_head(&slice.head_hash); ``` `HistorySlice` (`engine/src/audit/domain/anchor.rs`) field order: `scope · since · actions · head_hash · sig`; signing bytes = compact JSON with `sig=null`. Env: `RIGORIX_ANCHOR_URL`, `RIGORIX_ANCHOR_PUBLIC_KEY`, `RIGORIX_ANCHOR_SCOPE`. **Enterprise server** — `core/src/execution_api/`: ```rust // handlers.rs:34 Router::new().route("/api/v1/rpc", post(rpc_handler)).route("/rpc", post(rpc_handler)) // services.rs:415 method `rigorix.audit.history` pub async fn history(&self, _scope, params: LedgerHistoryParams) -> Result { let since = params.since.unwrap_or_else(|| epoch); self.ledger.history_slice(¶ms.producer_id, since).await } // LedgerHistoryParams { producer_id: String, since: Option> } // ledger.rs:102 -> slice.scope = producer_id; anchor::sign_slice(signer, &slice) ``` **The mismatch — why it can never work today:** | aspect | OSS `HttpAnchorClient` | enterprise server | |---|---|---| | transport | `GET` | `POST` | | path | `/v1/history` | `/rpc` (JSON-RPC 2.0) | | param | `scope` (query) | `producer_id` (JSON `params`) | | body | **bare `HistorySlice`** | `{"jsonrpc","id","result":…}` | | auth | none | team scope via `edge_auth` | ## Target State Pin **one** wire.
